en.hero_text: 118 acres in East Cairo built around a single green pathway you can walk or cycle end to end — from the central park to your own back gate.

sections.title: A neighbourhood where everyone knows your name.

pillars.title: Connected without the traffic
pillars.text: Direct access to Sokhna Road, South Teseen and the Mid Ring Road. Close enough to reach the city quickly, far enough not to hear it.

pillars.title: Green space came first
pillars.text: Most compounds lay roads and fit gardens into what's left. Here the pathway was drawn first and the homes arranged along it.

pillars.title: Built for the climate
pillars.text: Brickwork, masonry banding and timber hues, with double-height ceilings and deep terraces that handle Cairo's heat.

usps.title: A back gate onto the park
usps.text: Homes open directly onto the green spine — no walking around the block to reach it.

usps.title: A full cycling loop
usps.text: The path becomes a dedicated lane lined with flowering shrubs and benches, looping the whole community.

usps.title: Shops without leaving
usps.text: The commercial park carries groceries, cafés and daily essentials inside the gates.

usps.title: Art deco, built for heat
usps.text: PBD's architecture uses brick, masonry banding and deep terraces — nostalgic, but designed for the climate.

panels.title: Villas
panels.text: Detached homes in two design types, with the largest gardens and the most privacy in the community. Double-height living areas and expansive glass onto the terrace.

panels.title: Twinhomes
panels.text: Paired homes sharing a single wall — most of the villa footprint and the same architecture, at a lower entry point.

panels.title: Townhomes
panels.text: Arranged in short rows, each with a private garden and a back gate opening directly onto the green spine. Step out and you're already on the path.

panels.title: Private residences
panels.text: A small number of homes within the community, released in limited phases. Ask about what's currently available.

en.footer_disclaimer: Not the official Marakez website. Prices, plans and renders are indicative and subject to change; official terms are confirmed by Marakez at the point of sale.
